title: Desert Gathering & Shrine Marker, 1950s Snapshot, B&W, US West
description: A black and white snapshot from around the 1950s depicting a makeshift sign marker or roadside shrine in an arid desert landscape filled with sagebrush, surrounded by glass bottles, rocks, and tin cans. In the background, a small group of people gathers on the left while a couple stands observing the wide-open valley on the right. The photographer's shadow is visible in the lower foreground.
